$comment: The sections of the Eurth nation profile (<nation>.eurth.json, see eurth-org/eurth-profile) and the tool that writes each, for 'Your nation' on tools.eurth.org. section: the key in the file. label: what the page calls it. tool: the id in @eurth/style's tools.json. always: shown even before its tool is live, because the section gives nothing away. The build hands the page only the sections whose tools have launched; the rest are counted, never named. Please don't spoil the doors.
